classification: shared public contract and additive SQLite migration
reason: The change adds versioned public event contracts, shared persistence schema, migration behavior, and a filesystem projection.
publicContracts: delivery event and evidence DTOs v1
metric definition and snapshot DTOs v1
retrospective, proposal, experiment, and journal checkpoint DTOs v1

ownedEvents: versioned delivery event contract; downstream instrumentation defines event types through adapters

ownedMigrations: delivery telemetry schema v1 using the verified pre-migration backup path and targeted state_meta update
components.dependencyDirection: continuous-improvement-ledger -> state-database; state-database never imports improvement policy

direction: workflow completion, owner handoff, cost admission, and exact-SHA producers -> public adapter inputs -> continuous-improvement-ledger
continuous-improvement-ledger -> state-database and runtime-paths shared kernels
journal Markdown <- deterministic read-only projection from SQLite
forbidden: raw telemetry-table access outside the repository contract
policy copied from upstream evidence producers

rollbackBoundary.procedure: Set state_meta.deliveryTelemetryMigration.writerEnabled to false or deploy a runtime with repository writers disabled. Leave all additive tables and triggers readable. Rebuild or remove journal projections only after verifying SQLite remains intact.
rollbackBoundary.compatibility: Older runtimes ignore additive tables. Contract-v1 readers reject newer writer schema versions and ignore unknown additive fields supplied by future readers.
rollbackBoundary.dataRecovery: Restore the verified pre-migration SQLite backup only for migration failure; otherwise retain the append-only ledger and reconstruct journal files from retrospectives.
